title: Junction/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Specter Guardian: "This sacred Rail must be protected."
- Specter Guardian: "Leave this place or be returned to the Void."
- Specter Guardian: "I am a Warden of the Solar Rails. I am your death."
- Specter Guardian: "Only the sacred may pass. Heathens will perish."
- Specter Guardian: "How dare you enter my home? I guard the Rail with my shadow-life."
- Specter Guardian: "The Solar Rails bind our System. I will not see it undone."
- Specter Guardian: "Are you seeking a return to the Void? Challenge me and find destruction."
- Specter Guardian: "I am entrusted to protect this most sacred temple. A pathway into the Void. Flee or be consumed."
- Specter Guardian: "I have pledged my shadow-life to defend the Solar Rails."
- Specter Guardian: "I will purge your weakness from my Rail."
- Specter Guardian: "Another intruder... another corpse for the Void."
- Specter Guardian: "Only those worthy may enter. You face certain death to oppose me."
- Specter Guardian: "I am a being of the Void, created to oppose you. Leave now."
- Specter Guardian: "Come no further if you value your life."
